# Order of Battle

> Order of Battle is a free unofficial Age of Sigmar 4th edition army builder. You put a list together by regiment, add a Regiment of Renown when the army allows it, then keep wounds, spells, and phase abilities in front of you during the game. You don't sign up; the lists live on the device.

## About

Order of Battle is a browser hobby helper for Warhammer Age of Sigmar (4th edition). Free fan project: no ads, no subscriptions, no Games Workshop affiliation. Catalogue data comes from the community BSData Age of Sigmar 4th edition project. Points and rules in the app are helpers only. Confirm them with official Games Workshop publications before you play.
